contract.request_id: Optional UUID, ordinary uploads only; recovery plus request ID rejected by the RPC validator and actor function.
contract.identity: Object key is documents/request- plus SHA256(JSON [server actor.authUserId, normalized request UUID]); no client-supplied actor identity. Legacy requests retain random keys and additive behavior.
contract.intent_retry: Existing unique object_key with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING then separate matching read. Exact actor/company/case/checklist/category/filename/contentType/size/checksum required; recovery collisions refused. No expiry extension, lifecycle reset, or global checksum deduplication.
contract.finalize_replay: Reauthorize, require original authenticated requester for all roles, verify complete body size/hash, read actual getDocument metadata, validate current intent/document/version/scope/metadata chain, reauthorize after readback, return current document unchanged. No storage put, scanner, job or receipt operation in the committed branch.
contract.repository_replay: Existing case then intent lock order retained. Replay validates documentRows on the same transaction and returns without writes or enqueue. First finalize remains transactional with one document/version/scan/analysis/checklist receipt path.
contract.lineage: Private read projection additionally matches document category/filename and version filename/contentType/declared checksum/byte size to the intent. Missing/corrupt lineage remains refused.
contract.server_boundary: Shared chain assertion is lazily imported behind createServerOnlyFn; no new eager runtime SQL import into the server-fns module.
contract.public_return: Existing actual PrivateDocument shape, with currentVersionId. Quarantine/rejected/failed or business review states are returned as stored; replay does not establish scan safety or approval. Test getDocument fakes must include currentVersionId matching the intent.

parent_follow_up: Run actual gated SQL concurrency for same request key and concurrent first finalizes; observe exactly one intent/document/version/scan job/analysis job/checklist receipt and immutable review/audit metadata.

limitations: Only inert SQL and storage fakes were used here; no DB clients, real locks, real unique-index race, API transport, native Auth/RLS/storage/scanner or provider acceptance.

Two simultaneous initial actor finalizations can each reach storage.put before either receipt commits. The repository serializes receipt/jobs, and later committed retries never put. SQL proof remains a parent task; do not claim globally exactly one storage write during the initial race.
Expired status or inconsistent created-with-document states are rejected. A matching expired-created/no-document intent is returned without mutation so the UI can offer an explicit new attempt.
No migrations, schema, Portal, journal, DB fixture, Git mutation, push, merge or deployment performed by this delegated backend slice.
